brand_identity.concept: Museum of Archive Fashion Pieces / Laboratorio de Piezas de Autor
brand_identity.brand_flow: ARCHIVO → PIEZA → EXPEDIENTE → EDICIÓN → LIBERACIÓN → ADQUISICIÓN
brand_identity.tone_of_voice: Argentine Spanish with voseo (segura, auténtica, sensual, rebelde, cercana, estética de museo y laboratorio)
key_phrases: No necesitás más ropa. Necesitás mejores piezas.
No todo el mundo puede tenerla.
brand_identity.logo_concept: ARCHIVE in bold brutalist display typeface + 'lab' in fluid handwritten cursive script

typography.heading_font: Syne / Bodoni Moda / Cabinet Grotesk (Display Brutalist Serif/Sans mix)
typography.script_font: Caveat / Dancing Script (for 'lab' logo handwritten touch and designer notes)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono (for Dossier / Expediente numbers, QR codes, limited edition serials)
typography.font_pairing_rules: Headings in bold uppercase with tight letter-spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter). Overlines & Dossier references in Mono uppercase with wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]). Hand-written accents for Cami's signatures and 'lab' sub-logo.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight leading-none
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold uppercase tracking-tight

layout_and_spacing.grid_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-10
layout_and_spacing.museum_frame: border border-[#2A2A2A] relative bg-[#121212] transition-all duration-300 hover:border-[#555555]

key_sections_and_zones.hero_editorial: Impactful video/cinematic gallery backdrop with quiet ambient video, ARCHIVE lab logo, and main CTA 'EXPLORAR EL ARCHIVO'.
key_sections_and_zones.archive_catalog: Catalog with filter by Category (Denim Intervenido, Íntima/Corsetería, Accesorios, Carteras/Bolsos), Size (Talle 1, 2, 3, Único), and Availability (Libre, Reservado, Agotado).
key_sections_and_zones.expediente_dossier: Product Dossier modal/page featuring image gallery, Cami's concept notes, material interventions, measurements, total limited edition count, availability per size, and price in ARS.
key_sections_and_zones.vip_camila_guerra: Exclusive section for ultra-limited pieces with direct Cami Guerra approval and restricted numbers.
key_sections_and_zones.cart_and_checkout: Mercado Pago ARS mock integration with transparent summary, size selection, unit number reservation, and shipping options in Argentina.
key_sections_and_zones.my_archive_user_space: Private area for client showing acquired pieces, unique serial codes, status, and printable digital certificates.
key_sections_and_zones.qr_public_dossier: Public page accessible via QR/code showing piece authenticity, dossier details, and owner badge.
key_sections_and_zones.admin_panel: Protected laboratory backroom for piece creation, dossier editing, unit serial generator, QR generator, and order management.

instructions_to_main_agent.testing_data_testids: Ensure EVERY button, input, tab, card, modal, and link includes a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='explore-archive-cta', data-testid='filter-category-denim', data-testid='add-to-cart-button').
instructions_to_main_agent.header_navigation: The header must feature the ARCHIVE lab logo (bold 'ARCHIVE' + handwritten italic 'lab'), navigation links to Archivo, Expedientes, Camila Guerra VIP, Mi Archivo, and Admin, plus search and cart trigger.
instructions_to_main_agent.language_and_tone: Use Argentine Spanish (voseo) across all copy: 'Explorá', 'Elegí tu talle', 'Guardá en tu archivo', 'Comprá con Mercado Pago'.
instructions_to_main_agent.react_js_file_extension: Note that the codebase uses standard .js / .jsx file extensions for React components.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark editorial aesthetic: avoid generic white SaaS components or juvenile punk tropes.
Use layered z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/70 border border-white/10) for sticky elements and drawers.
Ensure interactive states have contrasting focus/hover borders and text highlights.
Include subtle motion using Framer Motion for dossier drawer reveals, photo zoom, and tab switching.
Provide clear feedback via Sonner toasts when adding items to cart or saving dossiers.
